start_here.title: Compare the direction of two published branches
start_here.task: Place the stacking section in Volume 4 beside the pulling section in Volume 5. Note which branch name matches the movement you are trying to understand. Owners can then use the opening Volume 6 combination lesson to record when the instructor changes branches, without assuming every reaction requires that change.
